## Vocabulary in Context (6 points)
Read each sentence. Choose one option that explains the bold word or phrase as it is used in that sentence.
**4.** Sam seemed to **recoil** as he lifted the lid.

What does **recoil** mean here? (1 point)
A. hold still in place
B. lean forward toward something
C. draw back from something
Correct answer: <i>C. draw back from something</i>
